## Overview
Microsoft reported a stellar Q3 FY24 with revenue of $61.9B (up 17% YoY) and an EPS of $2.94, beating estimates of $2.82. The quarter was defined by massive AI-driven acceleration in Azure and the successful broad deployment of Copilot across the enterprise ecosystem.

## Key Takeaways
- Total revenue of $61.9B, marking 17% YoY growth
- Intelligent Cloud revenue reached $26.7B (up 21% YoY)
- Azure revenue grew 31% YoY, with 7 points of growth directly attributed to AI services
- Productivity and Business Processes revenue grew 12% YoY to $19.6B

## Highlights
- Capital expenditures soared to $14B to support surging cloud and AI infrastructure demand
- Over 65% of Fortune 500 companies now use Azure OpenAI Service
- GitHub Copilot surpassed 1.8 million paid subscribers, a 35% quarter-over-quarter increase

## Investment Focus Areas
- **Products**: Microsoft 365 Copilot, Azure OpenAI, Dynamics 365 AI tools
- **AI & Cloud**: Global data center expansion, custom Maia AI accelerators
- **Strategic Priorities**: Embedding Copilot in every product surface and leading the enterprise AI platform shift
